thread:
Maya: filing PRD intake for SLO-driven fallback policy for latency bursts
Maya: Problem statement: during bursty traffic some Dedicated pools hit capacity and we see p95 tail spikes; customer UIs experience token stalls and timeouts. need a safe, observable fallback path.
Maya: Goal: deterministic, policy-driven fallback that routes new requests to a compatible lower-latency model variant when latency SLOs are violated, plus Console visibility and eval checks.
Maya: Non-goals: autoscaling changes, mid-request model swaps, changing model training. this is routing-level only.
Alex: quick ask: what counts as "compatible" model? quantized variants? smaller family? need explicit whitelist.
Jordan: ML note: compatibility = same model family + validated parity on eval set. quantized variants allowed if eval parity within threshold. we'll prepare per-model allowed fallbacks.
Sam: runtime constraints: we can only switch routing for new requests. in-flight streaming can't be migrated safely -> non-goal. also need to avoid cache/key-mismatch causing gibberish.
Maya: success metrics: 1) reduce customer-visible timeouts by 90% during bursts; 2) p95 <= 500ms for critical routes after fallback; 3) fallback rate < 5% monthly; 4) no increase in error/partial-token rates.
Alex: acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- Trigger: 1-min p95 latency > 500ms OR queue depth > 75 for a given pool/route
- Routing: new requests for affected route send to first-compatible fallback in whitelist
- Quality: fallback must preserve top-1 intent parity >= 97% on model-specific eval set
- Safety: no increase in truncated responses or decoding errors post-fallback
- Observability: Console shows fallback events, reason, affected pct, and latency delta; traces include fallback tag
- Rollout: Canary 1% for 24h, 5% for 72h, rollback if intent parity < 96% or latency p95 not improved
```
Jordan: test plan: automated eval job runs 5k prompts for each candidate fallback, compute embedding cosine and top-1 label match. store baseline metrics.
Sam: infra tasks: add route-level fallback policy config (API + Console), emit _fallback.event_ metric with {pool,route,fallback_model,reason}, update tracing to include fallback=true. estimate 2w infra work.
Maya: owners: Maya (PM), Jordan (ML), Sam (Runtime), Alex (Product Eng). ETA for MVP: 8 weeks.
Alex: edge cases we should call out: streaming + chunked responses (we won't migrate in-flight), prompt conditioning that depends on model tokenizer differences, model-specific stop sequence behavior. add to PRD.
Jordan: tokenizer differences can change token counts -> ensure token accounting in Console + billing unaffected. will add tests for stop-token behavior.
Sam: operational runbook: during canary enable SRE on-call watch, set alert on fallback spike and client error increases. include rollback playbook.
